Founded in 2015, our core philosophy is built around a strong product engineering mindset—ensuring every solution is architected and delivered right the first time. Today, Wissen Technology has a global footprint with 2000+ employees across offices in the US, UK, UAE, India, and Australia. Our commitment to excellence translates into delivering 2X impact compared to traditional service providers. How do we achieve this? Through a combination of deep domain knowledge, cutting-edge technology expertise, and a relentless focus on quality. We don’t just meet expectations—we exceed them by ensuring faster time-to-market, reduced rework, and greater alignment with client objectives. We have a proven track record of building mission-critical systems across industries, including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and more. Wissen stands apart through its unique delivery models. Our outcome-based projects ensure predictable costs and timelines, while our agile pods provide clients with the flexibility to adapt to their evolving business needs. Wissen leverages its thought leadership and technology prowess to drive superior business outcomes. Our success is powered by top-tier talent. Our mission is clear: to be the partner of choice for building world-class custom products that deliver exceptional impact—the first time, every time. Job Summary: We are seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in Bengaluru. Operating on-site, the successful candidate will design, build, and optimize scalable, resilient, cloud-native applications utilizing Python , AWS , and MongoDB . You will collaborate closely with cross-functional development, data, and infrastructure teams to champion modern software architecture, incorporate AI best practices, and contribute to production stability through structured incident management principles. Experience: 3 - 6 Years Location: Bangalore Mode of Work: Hybrid Education Qualification: MCA/B.E/B.Tech/MTech Key Responsibilities & Duties: Application Architecture & Backend Development Design, implement, and maintain high-performance backend microservices and APIs using Python and modern framework standards. Ensure code quality, security, and scalability through comprehensive unit/integration testing and peer code reviews. Apply design patterns and object-oriented programming principles to solve complex business problems. Cloud & Database Infrastructure Deploy, configure, and manage cloud services on AWS (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway). Model NoSQL data structures, optimize indexing, and tune query performance in MongoDB. Manage relational data components using PL/SQL scripts and stored procedures where hybrid relational databases are integrated. CI/CD, Containerization & AI Integration Implement continuous integration and deployment pipelines using modern CI/CD frameworks (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Leverage container orchestration tools like Kubernetes to streamline application deployments and maintain cloud resilience. Incorporate AI best practices (e.g., AI-assisted development tools, prompt engineering, or LLM-driven pipelines) into software development processes. Operational Support & Incident Management Actively participate in Incident Management workflows to investigate, triage, and resolve production outages. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical technical issues and implement long-term preventive remediation. Qualifications & Requirements: Education & Technical Experience Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field. Experience: Minimum 3 years to maximum 6 years of hands-on software development experience. Core Skill Requirements Primary Technologies: Advanced proficiency in Python, practical cloud experience with AWS, and database engineering in MongoDB. Good to Know Skills: Kubernetes and containerization concepts (Docker). Infrastructure deployment with modern CI/CD frameworks. Relational database querying with PL/SQL. Exposure to AI Best Practices and modern developer tooling. Operational Knowledge: Solid operational understanding of Incident Management standards and ITIL best practices. review_candidates.description: # Senior Software Engineer, Backend ## About the Role Bluesky is building a social media ecosystem designed to make social more like the web itself, with interconnected applications and clients supported by a shared protocol and identity. As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, you will build and maintain the infrastructure supporting moderation, anti-spam, and user safety. You will work closely with internal operations, product, and engineering teams to develop high-scale backend services for rapid abuse detection and prevention. The role focuses on high-volume data infrastructure, ETL pipelines, scalable backend systems, and monitoring and observability. ## Key Responsibilities * Design, implement, and maintain high-volume data pipelines and databases. * Create and manage ETL processes that support automated abuse prevention. * Assist with scaling and implementing backend systems for internal tools. * Collaborate with engineers across the organization to integrate safety systems into Bluesky products. * Develop monitoring and observability solutions for data infrastructure. * Build and maintain backend infrastructure supporting moderation, anti-spam, and user safety. * Contribute to high-scale services designed for rapid detection and prevention of abuse. ## Required Qualifications * 10+ years of extensive professional experience with Go. * Strong fundamental programming and software engineering skills. * Proven experience building scalable backend systems capable of operating at 1M+ operations per second. * Experience working with high-scale systems such as data services or load balancers. * Familiarity with the upper limits and operational characteristics of operating systems, networks, and storage. * Significant experience with database systems such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQLite. * Ability to work effectively on small, fast-moving engineering teams. ## Preferred Qualifications * Experience with additional data stores such as ScyllaDB/Cassandra, Redis, or ClickHouse. * Experience with search systems such as Elasticsearch. * Previous experience building or operating infrastructure for large-scale social applications. * Proximity to Seattle and willingness to travel to Seattle. ## Technical Skills * Go * Backend Software Engineering * High-Scale Distributed Systems * Data Pipelines * ETL * Database Systems * PostgreSQL * MySQL * SQLite * ScyllaDB / Cassandra * Redis * ClickHouse * Elasticsearch * Operating Systems * Networking * Storage Systems * Monitoring & Observability * Infrastructure Engineering * Moderation and User Safety Systems * Anti-Spam and Abuse Prevention ## Work Arrangement & Schedule * **Employment Type:** Full-time * **Work Arrangement:** Fully remote * **Location:** Remote * **Time Zone Requirement:** Working-hour overlap with Pacific Standard Time (PST) is required. * Proximity to and willingness to travel to Seattle is a plus. * The interview process may include an on-site component. ## Compensation & Benefits * **Base Salary:** $200,000–$270,000 * Equity is considered as part of the total compensation package. * Final base salary depends on geographic location, experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. * Health insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance
